Mathematical constants and special values

Source: R/aaa-core.R
constants.Rd

pi, Euler's number E, the imaginary unit I, positive and negative infinity oo and -oo, complex infinity zoo, not a number nan, and the constants EulerGamma, Catalan, GoldenRatio and TribonacciConstant. They are exported as objects of the same names prefixed with S_ (for example S_Pi) and, for convenience, as sym_pi, sym_E, sym_I, oo, zoo and nan.

Usage

sym_pi

sym_E

sym_I

oo

zoo

nan

EulerGamma

Catalan

GoldenRatio

TribonacciConstant

S_Pi

S_E

S_I

S_Infinity

S_NegativeInfinity

S_ComplexInfinity

S_NaN

S_Zero

S_One

S_Half

S_NegativeOne

S_true

S_false

S_EmptySet

Format

sym objects.

Examples

sym_pi + 1
#> 1 + pi
sym_I^2
#> -1
oo + 1
#> oo
